enchantment.aquamarine.deep_breath.desc: More time underwater: air lasts 30% longer per level (up to III). Works on helmets.

The harpoon passes through its target and flies on to the next within 8 blocks: +1 target per level (up to III). Works on harpoons.

jei.aquamarine.obtain.creative_only.1: Not in the world yet: they come with the Lost City, which has no phase yet.
